Dream?

Single · Artan Davoodi

An introspective song about identity, concealed emotion and the reflection of inner experience.

Release Date2026-09-20

Duration3:36

Apple MusicSpotifyYouTube MusicAmazon MusicDeezerTIDAL
Story

Dream? moves through learned emotional concealment, unsaid words, falling, mirrors and comparison. Its final recognition is that what appears outside may also reflect the self.

Lyrics

You say man don't cry So I learned how to hide Down in my dreams Where I still try

I kept words unsaid They echoed anyway Watching the world fade Day after day

I'm falling down Without a parachute Ignited eyes Wonder who is whom

Breathing mirrors No one set me free Awake in this dream Who's dream to be

Like a dying tree Roots still try to hold Every face that I look Compared against my own

My silence breaks apart I feel I need to know All there is and all I see Is a reflection of my own
